title: Washington court upholds home ownership ruling in $132,000 loan dispute between family friends
summary_full: A mortgage deal between Lorrie D. Carlson and Sonny H. Hwang spiraled into a series of legal battles. After Carlson lent Hwang $132,000, secured by a shared property, tensions arose when Hwang neglected his payments. Proceedings ensued as Hwang filed claims against Carlson. The appeals court deemed no consumer law breaches by Carlson but confirmed Hwang's clear title ownership, sending the case back for discussions on Carlson's attorney fee recovery.
